title: Shairi (Theme 6: Bendera ya taifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child recites with clear words and the beat of the poem, works out a word from its line, and says what the poet wants the reader to do.
representations: the poem on a chart, stanzas numbered
a clapped beat for each line
steps: Read the stanza aloud with its beat.
Use the line to say its meaning.
Say the message of the poem.

board.do: Nyeusi ni ya watu, nyekundu ni damu.
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child recites the stanza with the beat and says one thing the poem asks of us.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "taifa" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "nafaka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanaweza kusikika sawa na yasiwe na maana sawa. Taifa ni nchi na watu wake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "bendera" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "wimbo wa nchi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Bendera ni kitambaa chenye rangi kinachoonyesha nchi. Wimbo wa taifa ni wimbo rasmi wa nchi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "amani" lina maana gani?" Kwa nini "vita" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Amani ni hali ya utulivu bila vita. Vita ni kinyume cha amani.
Mada ni bendera; ujumbe ni kile mshairi anataka tufanye: tuiheshimu.

checks.question: Rangi nyeupe katika bendera ya Kenya inawakilisha nini?
Ujumbe wa shairi la bendera ni?
